governor.name: Justine Ezarik
governor.title: Governor of the State of Colorado
bio: Justine Ezarik is the 44th Governor of the State of Colorado. Before taking office, she represented Colorado in the United States Senate, where she championed legislation to expand access to affordable healthcare, lower costs for working families, protect public lands, advance clean energy, and strengthen voting rights. Her work in the Senate earned her a reputation as a pragmatic, results-driven leader committed to progressive policies and bipartisan problem-solving.

As governor, Justine will work to strengthen Colorado's public schools, expand access to affordable healthcare, increase the supply of affordable housing, accelerate the transition to clean energy, protect the state's public lands and water resources, modernize transportation infrastructure, and ensure state government is transparent, accountable, and responsive to every Coloradan.
Governor Ezarik lives in Denver with her family and is committed to working with communities across every corner of the state to build a more affordable, sustainable, and prosperous Colorado.

hero.headline: A government for every Coloradan.
hero.lede: From the snow-capped peaks of the Rockies to the high plains stretching eastward, the work of state government is to protect our communities, expand opportunity, and honor the responsibilities we share as Coloradans.
